title: Identity, workspace and personal onboarding
scope_items: Clerk JWT/JWKS validation, active session status verification, and transportauth WorkspaceVerifier
Synchronous verified-user mapping (SyncVerifiedUser) so delayed user.created webhooks never block login (RULE-AUTH-008, AC-1)
Preselection workspace discovery via active workspace_members join for owner and non-owner members (RULE-AUTH-002, RULE-AUTH-003, AC-2)
Svix-signed Clerk webhook verification and out-of-order monotonic reconciliation for user, membership, and session events

Password recovery single-use token validation, immediate revocation of all existing sessions, security email notification, rate-limit lockouts (>5/1h recovery, >10/5m login), and TOTP-only MFA enforcement (RULE-AUTH-004, RULE-AUTH-006, RULE-AUTH-007, AC-3)

Workspace invitations lifecycle (InviteMember, AcceptInvitation, RevokeInvitation, ResendInvitation) with normalized email matching, 7-day expiry, 50-pending cap, owner assignment block, and solo-tier cap

Self-scoped personal onboarding completion (WorkspaceService/CompleteOnboarding) writing strictly to user_preferences(user_id, workspace_id) without mutating workspace settings or home_dashboard_config (PRIV-2026-02, RULE-M01-005)
SvelteKit web auth routes (/login, /register, /forgot-password, /workspaces) and Flutter mobile auth session coordinator, secure token storage, workspace switcher, and personal onboarding state
verified_sub_slices: JWT RS256, exact issuer/audience/authorized party, expiry/nbf/iat/sid, JWKS bounded cache and rotation
Clerk session status lookup with active/revoked/expired/user mismatch test fixture
Transport user-facing WorkspaceVerifier required JWT + active session + active membership
SQL local active member and preselection nonowner discovery, tested against actual dev PostgreSQL
Real HTTP Connect mock service negative and authorized flow, Go race tests
JWKS anti-DoS remediation: RW lock for cache read, single-flight try-lock, detached 4s refresh, outage rate limiting; two new attack regression tests PASS
Clerk Svix webhook signature/timestamp verification and monotonic source_updated_at reconciliation + session revocation hooks (feat/p0-03-provider-sync)
Synchronous verified user provisioning fallback when user.created webhook is delayed (EnsureActiveUserWithSync / SyncVerifiedUser)
Password recovery challenge consumption, immediate revocation of all existing user sessions, security email dispatch, lockout enforcement, and TOTP-only MFA enforcement
Workspace invitation create/resend/revoke/accept with strict email normalization, 7-day expiry, 50-pending cap, owner role assignment denial, and idempotency replay detection (feat/p0-03-invitations)

Self-scoped personal onboarding completion (CompleteOnboarding + HomeOnboardingProjection) enforcing PRIV-2026-02 so non-admin and admin personal onboarding mutations only touch caller's user_preferences row
SvelteKit web auth client/session/discovery/routes and Flutter mobile auth client/session/UI/tests integrated cleanly across workspace

checks.command: python3 tooling/build_plan.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tooling/tests -v
bash tooling/ci/check_identity.sh with local PostgreSQL 17 test DSN (prior sub-slice run; no local PostgreSQL daemon running in current container)

remaining_scope: Actual Clerk production/staging instance and secret configuration; real issuer/audience/azp and live Clerk SDK end-to-end verification
P0-04 narrow DB reader privileges (creativanta_identity_discovery), canonical SQL migrations, and RLS policies for preselection workspace discovery and tenant tables
CI PostgreSQL 17.10 execution of newly integrated SQL tests in tooling/ci/check_identity.sh (local container does not run a PostgreSQL daemon)
Mounting business RPC and webhook routes onto cmd/api once P0-04 RLS and P0-05 RBAC/idempotency gates are satisfied
Independent security review, GitHub Actions CI green run, and release gating before ACCEPTED status
decisions: Cherry-picked all four sibling branches (0e3debb, 02433a3, 3c2e955, d9e1670) onto 03e423a cleanly without weakening any security or fail-closed checks.

Implemented WorkspaceService/CompleteOnboarding in apps/api/internal/identity/onboarding.go strictly scoped to user_preferences(user_id, workspace_id) per PRIV-2026-02 and RULE-M01-005, rejecting caller-supplied user_id, role, workspace settings, default_operator_mode, rewards, or demo fixtures.

Implemented RecoveryAndMFACoordinator and RevocationAwareSessionStatus in apps/api/internal/identity/recovery_mfa.go so password recovery immediately revokes all existing sessions (causing pre-reset JWTs to fail Resolver.VerifyWorkspace and DiscoverWorkspaces), dispatches security email notifications, enforces >5/1h recovery and >10/5m login lockouts, and enforces TOTP-only MFA.
Connected clerkwebhook.SQLReconciler session.ended and session.revoked events to SessionRevocationRecorder.
Kept production entrypoints (cmd/api, cmd/admin-api) fail-closed with business routes unmounted while P0-04 RLS and live Clerk credentials remain external gates.
notes: P0-03 code integration and local unit/race/web/mobile/proto/transport checks are complete (LOCAL_IMPLEMENTED / IMPLEMENTED_LOCAL_TESTED). Live Clerk credentials, P0-04 RLS/migrations, and CI PostgreSQL execution of the full SQL suite remain external gates; P0-03 is not claimed as ACCEPTED or production-ready.

security_review.confirmed_finding: HIGH - global JWKS cache mutex blocked during network I/O
security_review.remediation: Separate cache read lock from nonblocking bounded JWKS refresh; regression and outage throttling PASS
